name: 松江城天守
checkpoints: Exactly FOUR exterior principal roof levels, five internal floors; black timber rainboards on lower levels, small white plaster bands on upper levels.
Large triangular gables, top lookout balcony with dark wood railing, shachi ridge ornaments, central stone foundation.
Draw main tower and directly connected entrance projection; remove cherry tree, neighboring outbuildings and modern signs. Preserve the actual black-and-white wall distribution.
